text:
Start here: what TrueYards explains.

We break down how Indian property, rent and cities work, one clear explainer at a time: why Delhi has almost no skyscrapers, why the Noida twin towers were demolished, carpet vs super built-up area, RERA, CC and OC, and why stamp duty differs by city.

Every explainer cites its source. Educational content, not advice. Some visuals are AI-generated.
